description: Lists the valid category values for the category filter of search, with counts. scope templates (default) returns the website template categories (each with a count and, for some, a short description) under categories, plus the template kinds website, section and background under kinds; scope components returns the UI library categories (for example Hero, Three.js, Buttons) with the number of components and variants under componentCategories; scope all returns all three. Template counts cover the whole catalog and appear in a fixed display order, including categories with zero templates; component categories are only those that currently contain components. No pagination. Read-only.

scope.description: templates (default): website template categories and kinds. components: UI library categories. all: both.

name: list_categories

componentCategories.description: UI library categories (scope components or all)
